Oneliner

Soft X-ray sky monitor for high-energy astrophysics.
Description
  • Monitor deep space for high-redshift Gamma-ray Bursts (GRBs) using wide FOV.
  • Locate EM counterparts of gravitational wave events from black hole/neutron star mergers.
  • Monitor the sky and trigger alerts from high energy transient events (frequently associated with accreting black hole systems).
  • Technology development to create new opportunities for future constellations of CubeSats and/or larger missions.
